svg.title: Uno R3 Potentiometer Input and PWM LED

g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: For a red LED near 2 V with a 1 kohm resistor, current is about 3 mA.

g.desc: For a red LED near 2 V with a 1 kohm resistor, current is about 3 mA.

g.text: The LED path returns to GND. The potentiometer sets voltage, not LED current.

g.desc: The LED path returns to GND. The potentiometer sets voltage, not LED current.

g.text: KiCad ERC and exact-net checks required; physical measurements are unverified.

g.desc: KiCad ERC and exact-net checks required; physical measurements are unverified.

g.text: Uno A0 reads the potentiometer wiper; its ends use 5 V and GND.

g.desc: Uno A0 reads the potentiometer wiper; its ends use 5 V and GND.

g.text: The firmware shifts the 10-bit ADC result right by two to set Timer2 PWM on D11 / OC2A.

g.desc: The firmware shifts the 10-bit ADC result right by two to set Timer2 PWM on D11 / OC2A.

g.text: Use a separate series resistor with the external LED.

g.desc: Use a separate series resistor with the external LED.
